games_intro.title: THE SIDE-EYE ARCADE
games_intro.sub: Four games about the face you make when somebody says something ridiculous. No sign-up, no download, nobody asking to circle back. High scores run on the honor system. The Department is watching the honor system.
games_intro.footnote: No coworkers, dinner guests, or historical figures were harmed in the making of these games. Several were judged. Current Side-Eye Index: 8.6 on the Dolly Scale, up 0.4 since the last all-hands.

sideeye.kicker: A FUNNY HISTORY MAGAZINE + YOUTUBE SHOW · HISTORY, ALLEGEDLY
sideeye.title: SIDE EYE Magazine
sideeye.pitch: You always suspected the story you were told was... incomplete. You were right, and I'd like that entered into the record. The good news is the real version is wilder. Edwin and I dig it up, check every footnote twice, and tell it like we're on your porch and the sweet tea is running low. He brings the doubt. I bring the volume.
sideeye.issue_blurb: Vol. 1: The Losers Issue. History's runners-up, also-rans, and spectacular flops, starting with a modern army that went to war against emus and lost. The emus have not apologized.
sideeye.amazon_cta: Buy the print issue on Amazon
sideeye.sources_note: Every claim in the issue is footnoted. Check our work. Edwin already did, twice, and he's still squinting.
sideeye.future_issue_placeholder: Classified. Mostly because we're still writing it.
sideeye.show_pitch: Same stories, now with faces. Edwin and I trade notes on the parts of history that got sanded down, from the Great Emu War to Napoleon's backers to the Theranos patents that refuse to die. He's the skeptic. I'm the one saying "hang on" four times a minute.

fiction.title: Ms. Halprin's Overly Familiar Cloud
fiction.sub: A satire about grief, gadgets, and an AI that skipped straight to first names.

work.kicker: THE DAY JOB · FILED UNDER SERIOUS · EYEBROWS LOWERED
work.title: 17 years of B2B pipeline, built on purpose
work.intro: I lead demand generation and growth marketing for B2B SaaS: full-funnel pipeline, ABM, lifecycle, and the attribution that shows which dollars did the work. I built ABM from the ground up at FedEx, scaled pipeline at Optimizely, and helped grow a startup 900%. Today I run demand generation for the NeuroTech division at Control Bionics. Same instinct as the magazine: question the story, find what's true, then make it impossible to ignore.

about.title: Oh, and here's my face
about.bio: Heather Chappell started out in Clemson, South Carolina, finished growing up in Oxford, Mississippi, and graduated cum laude from Wake Forest. She still says y'all, and has converted three neighbors and one mail carrier. She co-creates SIDE EYE with Edwin, writes the occasional short story, and spends her days turning marketing budgets into pipeline. She has never once believed the first version of a story. This bio is the fourth.
about.sign_off: Come say hey. I answer faster than a smart cloud, and I'll call you whatever you like.
